newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Banpu rated sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banpu rated sell.

text.p: Asia Equity Ltd on Thursday recommended that investors sell Thai coal firm Banpu Plc as its share price was expected to fall.
"Banpu has just broken through its strong support at 400 baht. As a result, the share price can now move down towards 300 baht," Asia Equity said.
Banpu closed at 382 baht apiece on Wednesday. The stock was untraded so far on Thursday.
Asia Equity said the company was actively searching for new lignite reserves in Thailand, but industry sources indicated that there was very little saleable lignite left.

"Banpu also plans to bid for reserves from the Department of Mineral Resources, but competition will be heavy, and even if it wins, it will take two years to begin developing the mines," Asia Equity said.
It said Banpu's Sumatra mine project was originally scheduled to begin in July last year but had been delayed due to difficulties with the Indonesian government.
Banpu's stake in the project was likely to shrink to between 40-60 percent from the original 80 percent by the time the licence was finally granted, it added.
